```{r}
library(here)
library(tidyverse)
library(patchwork)
library(ggrepel)
```

```{r read in trait data}
bctraits.all <- read.csv(here("Data", "cleaned", "BC_bird_traits.csv"))
```


```{r Fire Index}
#building index:
index <- bctraits.all %>% 
  mutate(index_primary_lifestyle = ifelse(primary_lifestyle=="Insessorial"|for_hawking>51, 1, 0),
         index_primary_habitat = ifelse(primary_habitat == "Forest"|primary_habitat == "Woodland", -1, ifelse(primary_habitat == "Shrub"|primary_habitat == "Grassland"|primary_habitat == "Plains", 1, 0)),
         index_habitat_density = ifelse(habitat_density == "dense", -1, ifelse(habitat_density == "sparse", 1, 0)),
         index_forest_use = ifelse(forest_use == 1, -1, 0),
         index_foraging_location = ifelse(most_common_foraging_location=="canopy", -1, ifelse(most_common_foraging_location=="ground"|most_common_foraging_location == "understory", 1, 0)),
         index_trophic_niche = ifelse(trophic_niche == "Invertivore"|trophic_niche == "Nectarivore"|trophic_niche == "Granivore"|trophic_niche=="Frugivore", 1, 0),
         # #20th percentile for range size will be considered "small"
         index_migration = ifelse(migration == "sedentary", -1, 0),
         index_snag_use = ifelse(snag_nest>51, 1, 0),
         index_oldgrowth = ifelse(old_growth == 1, -1, 0),
         index_nesting_location = ifelse(most_common_nesting_location =="ground"| most_common_nesting_location=="grass"| most_common_nesting_location == "shrub", 1, ifelse(live_tree_nest >51, -1, 0)),
         index_nest_type = ifelse(nest_category=="cavity", 1, 0),
         index_handwing = ifelse(hand_wing_index > mean(hand_wing_index, na.rm = TRUE), 1, 0),
         index_foliageglean = ifelse(for_foliage_gleaning>51, -1, 0),
         index_sum = rowSums(across(starts_with("index")), na.rm = TRUE))
```

```{r}
index.save <- index %>% 
select(family, common_name, starts_with("index_"))
write.csv(index.save, here("Data", "cleaned", "index_for_appendix.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
```


```{r Figures}

(index1 <- ggplot(index, aes(x = index_sum, 
                  y = reorder(common_name, index_sum), 
                  color = index_sum)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, color = "black", linewidth = 0.75)+
  geom_segment(aes(x = 0, xend = index_sum, y = reorder(common_name, index_sum), yend = reorder(common_name, index_sum)),
               linewidth = 0.5, alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_point(size = 2.5) +
  scale_color_gradient2(low = "red", mid = "gray", high = "blue", midpoint = 0, name = "Index Score") +
  labs(x = "Fire Vulnerability Index Score", y = "Species") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
   facet_wrap(~family, scales = "free_y")+
  theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5), plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5), axis.text.y = element_text(size = 8), panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),legend.position = "bottom"))

               linewidth = 0.5, alpha = 0.7) +

  geom_point(size = 2.5) +

  ))
```

```{r}
family_summary <- index %>%
  group_by(family) %>%
  summarise(mean_index = mean(index_sum, na.rm = TRUE), sd_index = sd(index_sum, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>% 
  arrange(family)

(family <- ggplot(family_summary, aes(x = mean_index, y = factor(family, levels = rev(sort(unique(family)))))) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, color = "black", linewidth = 0.75) +
  geom_errorbarh(aes(xmin = mean_index - sd_index, xmax = mean_index + sd_index), color = "gray30", height = 0.4, linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_point(aes(color = mean_index), size = 3) +
  scale_color_gradient2(low = "red", mid = "gray", high = "blue", midpoint = 0, name = "Mean Index") +
  labs(x = "Fire Vulnerability Index Score", y = "Family") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10),
        legend.position = "bottom"))

ggsave(here("Figures", "index.family errorbars.png"), plot = family, width = 8, height =8)
```

```{r}
# Select top 10 and bottom 10 species by index_sum
top_bottom <- index %>%
  arrange(desc(index_sum)) %>%
  slice_head(n = 10) %>%
  bind_rows(index %>%
  arrange(index_sum) %>%
  slice_head(n = 10))

# Plot
(most <- ggplot(top_bottom, aes(x = reorder(common_name, index_sum), y = index_sum, fill = index_sum)) +
  geom_col() +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_fill_gradient2(low = "red", mid = "gray", high = "blue", midpoint = 0, name = "Index Score") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 14) +
  labs(x = "Species", y = "Index", title = "Most affected species", fill = "Index"
  ))
ggsave(here("Figures", "index.most10.png"), plot = most, width = 8, height =8)

```

```{r}
(spp <- index %>%

  ggplot(aes(x = index_sum, y = reorder(common_name, index_sum), color = index_sum)) +

               linewidth = 0.5, alpha = 0.7) +

  labs( x = "Fire Vulnerability Index Score", y = "Species") +

  facet_wrap(~family, scales = "free_y")+
  theme(axis.text.y = element_text(size = 9), legend.position = c(0.9, 0.05), legend.justification = c("right", "bottom")
  ))
#same figure but with spp name alphabetized:
(spp <- index %>% 
  filter(family %in% c("Anatidae", "Picidae", "Tyrannidae", "Turdidae", "Parulidae")) %>% 
  group_by(family) %>% 
  mutate(common_name = factor(common_name, levels = sort(unique(common_name), decreasing = T))) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = index_sum, y = common_name, color = index_sum)) +
  geom_segment(aes(x = 0, xend = index_sum, yend = common_name), linewidth = 0.5, alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_point(size = 2.5) +
  scale_color_gradient2(low = "red", mid = "gray", high = "blue", midpoint = 0, name = "Index Score") +
  labs(x = "Fire Vulnerability Index Score", y = "Species") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
  facet_wrap(~family, scales = "free_y") +
  theme(axis.text.y = element_text(size = 9), legend.position = c(0.9, 0.05), legend.justification = c("right", "bottom")))


ggsave(here("Figures", "selectfamilies.png"), plot = spp, width = 10, height =8)

```
